page.notes: The first Greek entry at the top of the left column is hard to read; the reading is doubtful. Several entries have Latin abbreviations or words that are uncertain or may be printing errors, including "fidofam" (Tobias entry), "prophetā", "tyranni fluctu", and "quando q;". The page number at the bottom centre is faint and may not be a page number. Text at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is omitted. The column entries have no printed line breaks marked apart from the "- " hyphens that were kept.
